reasoning: The extraction completely failed to preserve any of the 8 hyperlinks present in the source PDF, which constitutes a critical defect. Additionally, there are several major defects, including the inclusion of full-page screenshot images that visually duplicate the text content below them, incorrect list numbering resets, and retained header/footer elements. Due to the critical defect of missing hyperlinks, the document must be rejected.

concerns.description: Source PDF has 8 hyperlinks but output has none — all links lost during extraction
concerns.analysis: source_link_count=8, output_link_count=0. PDF URI annotations were not preserved as link elements.

The source document features single continuous numbered lists within each section that are separated by images. In the output JSON, these are split into multiple separate list objects without a starting index, which causes the numbering to reset to 1 after every image instead of continuing (e.g., items 3, 4, 5 become 1, 2, 3).
